front: TC092: What is the minimum viable move?
back: One truthful bridge, then one precise point: “I can see why that read makes sense. I see one part differently: the timing, not the demand.”

front: TC092: What is the core sequence?
back: Face bridge + specific difference + shared criterion + dignified next step. -> I can see why speed is the priority. I see the launch date differently because the support load is still unresolved. Could we separate the launch decision from the demo decision? -> That concern makes sense. I disagree with the conclusion that we should pause everything. Could we name the specific risk and reduce just that part? -> I agree with the goal of keeping it simple. I do not think this version is simpler for the user. Could we test it against the first-time-user path? -> Boundary version: I understand why you would ask. I cannot agree to that. What I can do is send the first version by Friday..

front: TC092: What is the field tip?
back: Save the person before you challenge the point.

front: TC092: What is the strong version of: No, that is wrong.?
back: I can see why that would be the first read. I see one part differently: the issue is timing, not demand.

front: TC092: What is the strong version of: This plan will not work.?
back: The goal is right. I do not think this plan protects the support team. Could we test it against the first-week workload?

front: TC092: What is the strong version of: That is unreasonable.?
back: I understand why you would ask. I cannot do that timeline. What I can do is send the first version by Friday.

front: TC092: What is better than: So many validating things that the point of difference never actually lands.?
back: One bridge, then the specific disagreement — said plainly.

front: TC092: What is better than: Saying 'I agree' when you do not.?
back: Agree only with the part you genuinely endorse: the goal, the concern, the pressure.

front: TC092: What is better than: Generic praise, criticism, generic praise.?
back: A truthful bridge and a clear difference — no filler praise.

front: TC092: What are signs it is working?
back: They ask about the specific point instead of defending their identity. They clarify, refine or narrow their claim. Their posture or tone softens. They can repeat your disagreement back without caricaturing it. They offer a next step, alternative, test or trade-off.

front: TC092: When should you avoid this technique?
back: There is immediate danger or a required safety escalation. The other person is acting in bad faith and using your politeness as a shield.

front: TC092: What is the best recovery line?
back: I am not challenging your intent or your effort — I am challenging this one specific point.
